# Motor Inn Auto Group

> The canonical customer website is https://www.motorinnautogroup.com. Source-backed, AI-readable dealership and inventory resources are published on the matching read-only discovery host.

- [AI-readable site index](https://ai.motorinnautogroup.com/llms.txt)
- [Full AI-readable site guide](https://ai.motorinnautogroup.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Current new inventory](https://ai.motorinnautogroup.com/new-inventory.md)
- [Current pre-owned inventory](https://ai.motorinnautogroup.com/used-inventory.md)
- [Current offers](https://ai.motorinnautogroup.com/offers.md)
- [OpenAPI agent contract](https://ai.motorinnautogroup.com/openapi.json)
- [MCP endpoint](https://ai.motorinnautogroup.com/mcp)
- [Search vehicles](https://ai.motorinnautogroup.com/api/v1/vehicles)
- [Carroll service information](https://ai.motorinnautogroup.com/api/v1/service-information)
- [Service scheduler handoff](https://ai.motorinnautogroup.com/service-scheduler)
- [Parts information](https://ai.motorinnautogroup.com/api/v1/parts-information)

DealerVault/Athena inventory is matched to current public DealerOn vehicle pages before a unit is published. Customer and lead data are never included.
